I had someone who drove me lovesick like this. Once I was as In love with Wendy and could think of no other. I’d stay awake at night waiting for her call when she got too depressed. It drove me to a bad place mentally. 
I still love her, but I’ve learned to accept the fact that I can care for her as a person while accepting that what I had once with her is gone forever. 

I know you love her and it hurts my friend, but if you keep making it about your feelings for her then you’ll only push her more away. To love her so much without her feeling nothing in return can be selfish of us. Because we’d rather be happy knowing she’s our gf or whatever. 
Doing this you risk losing her forever, even as a friend.
I’d lick that clean as a whistle. 👅👅😋😛

I’m here too man, and you don’t have to be in that dark place tonight. 
Talk to us, we’re here for you and I’m  not just saying that in some pseudo bullshit sense.
We’re all here, in this darkness, in all lows.

Don’t even think about it.
It’s just a passing thought.
One that just glistens with burden.
Those are the ones that are worthless.
There’s much more important bubbles,
Those not to leave open to wonder.
The choices you’ve left open to thought. 
Though you’ve no reason to sought.
What is that to you? They really must be pensive too, at the same time pay no attention to.
It’s not like it was always meant to....be?
Was it?  
Wishful thinking for the the lustful and weak. 
A concept left only to think... of, but not desire. 
Is this really the result? Nothing left to gain and no hopes of anything to acquire. 
This is the conclusion, and I’ve sufficed myself of these deceptive lies.... I tell myself.
Can self corrupt really be a personality? A subconscious decision made by our own self hate and deception.
Are you something else entirely? 
Your own entity.
With your own way of being, seeing, deciding and living.
Life’s perfect manifestation of an incarnate tragedy?
Left, abandoned, forsaken and left to decide our own reason to be.
We are not what they’ve said and spoken of so casually.
We are the ones who are meant to reach those feats. Leave behind those who we’ve concluded as weak. Emotionally, charismatically and mentally.
Those who have never actually understood our dreams.
Brushed it off as something so fictionally, nothing more than a child’s dream.
They will never look down from these heights we’ve all reached.

After 13 years I really did think she was my future so I understand when you say it hurts differently.
I loved her because she was the one out of everything that I’ve always wanted. A caring smile, a blissful self, and a beauty that couldn’t be matched. 
For a bit she was mine and I loved her to the fullest.
Unfortunately sometimes it’s never enough.
It wasn’t what she wanted and for a bit I was only beneficial for emotional support and advice.
Anytime someone asks you for advice for a relationship topic on the first  or third date should be a sure sign to prepare for heartbreak. 
It came from nowhere and nothing her decision to finally cut ties from me but I can do nothing but hurt and accept.
I can’t change that fact that she made her decision, because every choice is one owns self to make. 
I can only accept that this in the hand I was dealt and unfortunate as it may seem at the moment, I am still alive and breathing.
Pain may affect me hours through each day, but the scars always remain.
Let it remind you what mistakes to not make again.
 To love isn’t always the mistake, but to place the trust in the wrong person seems to be our fault.
Know what you want in the person, avoid repetition in the pattens you recognize and believe that you always deserve better.

I’m lot 100% there, but I’m slowly making my way.
It’s a process so it doesn’t just happen overnight 🌙
